Chapter 7155: Not Much To It

Chapter 7155: Not Much To It

The sinflames could herald an apocalypse. However, Li Qiye opened his mouth to suck them in before releasing them back.

“You can have them back.” He said.

The form he gave them back was just a regular flame, not sinflame. Nonetheless, Qilin was shocked to see this, realizing the flame could extinguish his eternal lamp.

This inconspicuous flame turned out to be his sinflame, wielding a negative karmic string. He couldn’t dodge it since this was his tribulation. If he could surpass it, he would be on his way to the other shore.

“Raa!” Gluttonous Beast interfered and devoured the sinflame with Limitless Devouring.

“Rumble!” Alas, the special sinflame continued to pierce through the boundless space within the beast.

Cracks appeared on his body with embers surging out, causing him to bellow in agony.

“Damn!” Kun Peng and Qilin became alarmed and channeled their chaos true energy, life force, and dao power together.

“Divine Beast Seal!” They roared and sealed Gluttonous Beast, hoping to suppress the sinflame. Gluttonous Beast did the same.

“Szz...” They successfully extinguished the internal sinflame.

Earlier, although Li Qiye swiftly defeated Death Serpent and Lunar Wolf, they were only seriously injured. However, that sinflame nearly killed Gluttonous Beast.

“Not much to it.” Li Qiye shook his head: “You all are not qualified to act as nobles looming above the other races. You’re no different from the rest in my eyes.”

This made them feel like ants, rather than the true dragons they once were, with immortals as servants and overlords as worshippers. This humiliation was unbearable.

“Beast Rise!” Kun Peng shouted and shifted between the two forms.

The other four beasts answered the call. Qilin disappeared; his lamp turned into an eternal totem. Gluttonous Beast became the largest black hole - another totem. Death Serpent’s colossal body became a totemic river. Finally, Lunar Wolf disappeared, leaving behind an indelible howl.

Kun Peng turned into the beginning of all things. The five totems fused as one.

“True Dragon’s Return!” Their totems were imprinted into the sea of wisdom.

The sea then turned into a true dragon. Its bloodline’s aura engulfed the world, seemingly capable of grasping the high heaven.
